question: Is there a discount code or a good deal on the Aurzen ZIP Pro projector right now?
query: Aurzen ZIP Pro projector discount code deal price October 2026

rec.answer:
**Yes—Aurzen currently lists the ZIP Pro for $579.99, down from $629.99**, a $50 saving (about 8%) on its US store. That’s the clearest directly advertised deal I found. citeturn0search8

- **Code: `CJ10`** — a third-party deal site reports 10% off and says it tested the code in Aurzen’s cart on October 25, 2026.
- **Important catch:** that same listing says it **doesn’t combine with automatic sale prices**. Although it advertises $57.99 off, I wouldn’t assume you’ll get another 10% off the $579.99 sale price. I haven’t independently verified it at checkout. citeturn0search15

**My recommendation:** [open Aurzen’s ZIP Pro listing](https://aurzen.com/products/aurzen-zip-pro-full-hd-portable-projector), try `CJ10`, and compare the final total with the **$579.99 no-code price** before paying.

Also, don’t confuse this with the much cheaper **original ZIP** deals or Aurzen’s “up to 60% off” headline—those aren’t the advertised discount on the **ZIP Pro**. citeturn0search0turn0search8
